research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: comScore is researching predictive detection of real-time and future ad viewability by learning probability distributions from historical viewing data, and systems and methods of personifying viewership data that aggregate tuning signals and household member attributes into person level viewing distributions. It is also developing methods for combining measurements based on beacon data to determine usage metrics. Together these efforts focus on audience viewability, individual level measurement, and cross-source usage estimation.

overview_description.description: comScore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is the cross-platform measurement company that precisely measures audiences, brands and consumer behavior everywhere. comScore completed its merger with Rentrak Corporation in January 2016 to create the new model for a dynamic, cross-platform world. Built on precision and innovation, our unmatched data footprint combines proprietary digital, TV and movie intelligence with vast demographic details to quantify consumers' multiscreen behavior at massive scale. This approach helps media companies monetize their complete audiences and allows marketers to reach these audiences more effectively. With more than 3,200 clients and global footprint in more than 75 countries, comScore is delivering the future of measurement. For more information on comScore, please visit comscore.com.

product.name: Cross-Platform Audience Measurement
product.description: Measures audiences and media consumption across digital, television, connected TV, mobile, and other platforms for media planning, buying, and evaluation.

product.name: Advertising Measurement
product.description: Measures and evaluates advertising exposure and performance across digital, television, connected TV, and other media environments.

product.name: Television Measurement
product.description: Measures television audiences, including national and local viewing, to support programming decisions, advertising transactions, and campaign evaluation.

product.name: CTV Measurement
product.description: Measures connected TV audiences and viewing across streaming services, devices, and screens for planning, transactions, and campaign evaluation.

product.name: Digital Audience Measurement
product.description: Measures audiences for websites, mobile apps, video, and other digital content, including traffic, demographics, reach, and engagement.

product.name: Marketing Impact
product.description: Evaluates how advertising and marketing activity affects brand and business outcomes, helping organizations assess campaign effectiveness and return on investment.
